objective: Close the M49 substrate boundary-observability gap by exporting Sentaurus-native substrate-contact electron face flux on diagnostic-only replays of the unchanged M47 default-BGN-on states.

diagnostic_replay.input_tdrs: exact M47 input_fps.tdr files inherited from the frozen M8 process outputs
diagnostic_replay.deck_rule: byte-equivalent M47 File, Electrode, Physics, Plot, Math solver controls, and Solve bias schedule, with only one top-level CurrentPlot Tcl diagnostic section added
diagnostic_replay.terminal_replay_anchor: M47 and M48 exact terminal component rows

native_observable.orientation: ContactSurfaceNormal orientation reported without post-hoc sign fitting; both outward integral and its signed residual to the native terminal eCurrent are retained

analysis.primary_bridge: Vela-minus-Sentaurus substrate electron difference using the M50 native Sentaurus face flux and the frozen M48 Vela substrate electron terminal current
analysis.same_solver_closure: compare the M50 contact-domain face integral with the same-run Sentaurus substrate eCurrent
analysis.state_replay_check: compare all six same-run Sentaurus source, drain, and substrate carrier components with frozen M47/M48 rows
analysis.target_localization: the absolute Vela-minus-native-Sentaurus substrate difference at n23 Vg=0.05 exceeds both adjacent n23 gates and matched n19 Vg=0.05
analysis.outcome_policy: native-bridge-closed, native-observable-mismatch, or replay-state-mismatch are all reportable outcomes; only the first permits the M49 observability gap to be declared closed
analysis.claim_guard: M50 validates observability and terminal localization only; it does not identify a production-code defect or authorize physics/default changes

forbidden_work: global HFS parameter scans or default tuning
BGN, SRH, mobility, contact, solver, mesh, or production-default changes
adding HeteroInterface, Thermionic, or Discontinuity physics
rewriting M8 or M45 through M49 artifacts
deliverables: regression test for contract and evidence invariants
